nodes.label: 11. Owner checklist before the first public push
nodes.norm_label: 11. owner checklist before the first public push

nodes.label: If you find a leaked secret
nodes.norm_label: if you find a leaked secret

nodes.label: Unnamed and ungendered; English inside, Portuguese outside
nodes.norm_label: unnamed and ungendered; english inside, portuguese outside
nodes.rationale: One inner language keeps prompts, memory and search consistent; translation only in presentation layer.

nodes.label: Hidden-layer leak test
nodes.rationale: Prompts are built by one function taking only Resident-facing types; any hidden field name or atlas label fails CI.

nodes.label: Body systems (health, nutrition, hydration, thermo, injury, illness)
nodes.norm_label: body systems (health, nutrition, hydration, thermo, injury, illness)

nodes.label: Deviations from original Gemini plan
nodes.rationale: No server-side headless renderer (symbolic perception), no Ollama (hosted free APIs behind adapter), cached polling not WebSockets, blank slate only prompt/memory-level.

nodes.label: Hard Rules (9)
nodes.rationale: Never-violate constraints: $0 cost, hidden state never shown to Resident, nothing scripted, no content filtering, public read-only, append-only logs, permanent death, secrets only in secrets stores, tune rates not story.

nodes.label: No content censorship / Discoverable, not censored
nodes.norm_label: no content censorship / discoverable, not censored
nodes.rationale: No filter blocks words like AI or simulation; truth findable via research; security only protects infrastructure and keys.

nodes.label: Nothing is planned (no scripting)
nodes.rationale: Designer supplies only physics, needs, senses, tools, memory; story beats must be emergent.

nodes.label: Resource economy and 14-day gentle start
nodes.rationale: Abundance multiplier 1.5x fading to 1.0x over 14 days so first week is survivable but not guaranteed.

nodes.label: Fetch guard
nodes.rationale: https only, no private IPs, 2MB cap, 8s timeout, text only; stops SSRF into infrastructure.

nodes.label: Governor modes
nodes.rationale: Normal, thrifty, reading_only, idle, hibernating; 10-minute pace kept whenever budget allows.

nodes.label: Feel a body, never a number
nodes.norm_label: feel a body, never a number
nodes.rationale: Constructed-emotion model: emotion words are the Resident's own interpretation, never supplied by the system.

nodes.label: Read-only public
nodes.rationale: No spectator input removes prompt-injection-from-visitors, moderation and abuse costs.

nodes.label: Admin routes (ADMIN_TOKEN)
nodes.rationale: hide only flips a flag; takedown lever, not a filter.

nodes.label: Platform terms exposure risk
nodes.rationale: Unfiltered open web shown publicly may cause suspension; mitigations are admin hide flag, full logs, archive/export to move hosts.

nodes.label: Global search (FTS + pg_trgm, PT via translations)
nodes.norm_label: global search (fts + pg_trgm, pt via translations)

nodes.label: Storage plan (traces to GitHub Releases)
nodes.rationale: ~3 MB/day of traces vs ~500 MB DB; keep 14 days full then archive with stub rows.

nodes.label: Time model (timeline of timestamped events)
nodes.rationale: Server never simulates at 60 FPS; viewer replays and interpolates so mid-tick visitors see mid-action.

nodes.label: Autonomic reflexes
nodes.rationale: 10-minute ticks mean the body must not be helpless between decisions; reflexes never choose goals.

nodes.label: LLM proposes, code disposes
nodes.rationale: LLM emits typed Actions; a deterministic engine validates and applies; LLM never sets coordinates, inventory or vitals.

nodes.label: phase label (unaware/questioning/revealed)
nodes.rationale: Descriptive label derived from beliefs; never a trigger.
